explanation: Grouping by every column but order_line_id puts each copy with its original, so each set's size minus 1 is its number of copies, and their sum is the answer. COUNT(DISTINCT order_line_id) finds nothing, because every copy has an ID of its own. Grouping by order and product alone also counts two real lines of one product as a copy, and summing the whole size of each copied set counts the originals too.
